== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[The Nye]] are humanoid entities composed of shadows and cloth rather than flesh. Functioning as the keepers of a specific [[House]], they perform domestic duties such as sweeping and laundry, but they are also known to attack outsiders by attempting to strangle them with [[chains]]. In combat, they utilize various chain techniques, ranging from heavy, armor-smashing swings to nimble maneuvers used for disarming opponents or sneaking up on victims from behind. While many Nye are identical in appearance, they possess certain supernatural abilities, including the capacity to move with grace, run lightly, and travel unseen. They are also capable of producing light and can appear to swarm an area rapidly. A distinct individual known as the [[Eldest]] serves as the leader of [[the Nye]]. This entity is characterized by a hunched posture, faded gray robes with long, voluminous sleeves, and a voice described as harsh or grating. Unlike many of his kind who are bound to [[the House]], the [[Eldest]] possesses greater freedom of movement and significant insight, claiming he can discover much if he chooses. [[The Nye]] are deeply connected to the essence of [[Valinhall]], and their history is tied to a founder named [[Valin]], who united the shards of their territory.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|[[The Nye]] are [[Shadow|shadow-folk]] inhabiting [[Valinhall]] who serve as the keepers of [[the House]]. Composed of layers of [[black cloth]] and pale moonlight that flows like [[blood]], these beings wear black robes and move with a graceful, eerily silent swiftness. They utilize [[black chains]] to strangle outsiders and test those who seek them with rage, though they cannot be killed by swords and view such wounds as badges of honor. Bound to their home, [[the Nye]] do not leave [[the House]] and possess an essence capable of slowing time. They are known to craft thin leather shoes and can move unseen, even appearing behind individuals to hold them in metal nooses.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[The Nye]] are beings composed of shadows and clothing that possess a life-giving essence linked to moonlight. Residing in [[Valinhall]], these figures appear as men wearing hooded black cloaks and function as bundles of cloth given life. They serve the [[armory]] by repairing weapons at a forge and returning swords to their designated racks in the [[entry hall]], an existence that helps accelerate [[Indirial]]. Led by an [[Eldest]], these entities can exhibit a cold breath and have been known to use lengths of cold metal to constrict a victim's throat. Ultimately, [[the Nye]] are capable of collapsing entirely into shadows and moonlight essence.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[The Nye]] are a powerful group of beings that exist as shadowy forms capable of swarming like ants. These entities possess the ability to materialize seemingly out of nowhere and can manipulate or communicate with intelligent guardians. During an attack on the [[inhabitants]] of [[Valinhall]] intended to test their alertness, [[the Nye]] lost their grip on their [[chains]]. Despite their presence in various locations, they remain a group that [[Valin]] has never been able to understand.}}
